test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held On: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. The promotion of congenial relationship at all levels of the staff leads to prosperity of the organisation.

B. Better skills increase the working capacity of employees by promoting better work habits.

C. This includes multiplication of knowledge and development of their skills.

D. Efficient management aims at qualitative improvement of its employees.
solution:
The correct answer is 'DCBA'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**While arranging the parts of the passage, we should find some __grammatical or contextual__ connections between them. Also, the first sentence of a passage is usually independent and introduces a topic. The second one provides more information about it. 

__
 
• Sentence D is the independent sentence and introduces the topic under discussion which is the aim of efficient management. 
 
• So, sentence D is the first sentence after rearrangement. 
 
• Sentence C which talks about what the qualitative improvement includes should come in the **second position.** Hence, C follows D.__
 
• Sentence **B** talks about the benefit of better skills that efficient management can help employees to acquire. this comes in the **third position. **
 
• Sentence A is the concluding sentence as it points out how all the other aspects help an organisation to prosper. 

Thus, the correct order after rearrangement is option 1 i.e. DCBA.

So, the correct paragraph is : ***(******D) Efficient management aims at qualitative improvement of its employees. (C) This includes multiplication of knowledge and development of their skills. (B) Better skills increase the working capacity of employees by promoting better work habits. (A) The promotion of congenial relationship at all levels of the staff leads to prosperity of the organisation.***
